version: v11 (2026-10-16), restyle of the v10 supplementary figures; numbers unchanged
helpers: scripts/4_visualization/paper_v11/si11_common.py (copy of paper_v10/common.py with the v11 palette; named so that other v11 helper modules are not overwritten)
medium: Scientific Reports supplementary information, 180 mm wide, PDF + PNG 600 dpi

style.font: FreeSans 7 pt (ticks and direct labels 6.5 pt, heat-map values 6 pt), panel letters 8 pt bold; text #262626 (white only inside dark heat-map cells, chosen by WCAG contrast)
style.lines: axes and ticks 0.5 pt #404040; data lines 0.8-1.0 pt (Physics + residual ML 1.0, Stefan recalibrated and Direct ML 0.9, Stefan source 0.8); zero/reference 0.5 pt #8C8C8C; light grid #E8E8E8 0.4 pt at major ticks of the value axis
style.markers: circles 3.5 pt, squares 3.1 pt (equal area), Stefan source squares 3.0 pt, Direct ML open circles 3.4 pt (edge 0.6 pt)
style.methods: Stefan (source coeff.) #8C9BAB squares; Stefan (recalibrated) #2E6DA4 squares; Physics + residual ML #D1603D filled circles; Direct ML #8E5B9E dashed, open circles
style.S1: observations dark grey; Stefan curve and site fits #2E6DA4 (solid Samoylov, dashed Kurungnakh); Alaska density in two tints of #3B3B8F; Lena Delta / Canada points and regression lines in region colours
style.S2: colour = model structure (D0 #8E5B9E, F1 #C9A227, D1 #4C9A7A, R1 #D1603D), marker = region; b: Physics + residual ML filled, Direct ML open
style.S3: input groups in the deck SHAP colours (v9_f10_extra.GROUP_HEX): climate #4F7CAC, terrain #8C8C5A, soil #A8744F; in-bar numbers dark grey or white by contrast
style.S10: v11 method colours; Physics + residual ML band = tint of #D1603D; markers 3.0 pt circles / 2.7 pt squares
